normalized.result: Yes, that handles the accidental blank correctly. Erasing the title and hitting Save keeps the editor open, flags the title field, and explains I need a title so I can recognize the bookmark later — instead of quietly saving a nameless link I'd never find again. And your assumption fits how I'd think about it: a title is the thing that makes a bookmark recognizable, so it shouldn't be allowed to go empty, while a description is nice-to-have and fine to leave blank. Good.
